{{Top|leg}}
A '''damage control system''' was a [[Computer/Legends|computer]] system designed to report damage to the crew of a [[Starship/Legends|starship]]. The damage control system on the [[Crusader-class corvette|''Crusader''-class corvette]] was prone to giving false damage reports.<ref name="MtS8">{{Wizards|url=default.asp?x=starwars/article/Mesop8|text=Message to Spacers 8}}</ref>
